The criteria consist of the following:

1. The employee has a minimum of one (1) year seniority;

2. Has no active Attendance Improvement Steps on record;

3. Has had no more than two (2) Sick Leaves of Absence within the 36 months prior to the date the Record Review is conducted;

4. The unexcused absence did not occur on a day specified in Paragraph 9 above, or the first scheduled workday following a layoff;

5. The absence did not occur on a day that has been specified in advance to the Local Union by Local Management to have a historical pattern of high absenteeism;

6. The reason for such absence does not meet the FMLA eligibility requirements

The criteria listed above will be jointly reviewed by Labor Relations and the District Committeeperson for the District in which the employee works.

## NATIONAL COMMITTEE ON ATTENDANCE

13. The National Committee will review attendance data and discuss ways to reduce unwarranted absenteeism.
